meta_title: MesterWeb – Modern websites for small businesses
hero_title: Give your business a website that builds trust.
hero_text: Modern, fast and mobile-friendly websites for small businesses – hairdressers, tradespeople, workshops, restaurants and local service providers.
hero_card_title: One website. Many types of business.
hero_card_text: The structure can be reused while the content and design are adapted to each client.
services_title: The same foundation, a completely different business.
services_intro: The MesterWeb template system is designed so it can later be customized quickly for many types of clients.
service_1_text: Services, price list, gallery, booking request and contact.
service_2_text: Quick contact, service area, work examples and quote requests.
service_3_text: Workshop presentation, repairs, brands, opening hours and booking.
service_4_text: Menu, gallery, opening hours, location, reservations and contact.
examples_title: See what the same system can become.
examples_intro: The images and texts here are demo content. Each client gets their own branding, copy and photos.
example_hair_text: Hairdressing, beauty treatments, prices, services and appointment requests.
example_electric_text: Services, service area and fast quote requests.
example_auto_text: Repairs, workshop, opening hours and booking requests.
example_restaurant_text: Menu, gallery, opening hours and reservations.
highlight_title: It is not about selling the exact same template.
highlight_text: The foundation can be shared, but every client gets their own copy, images, services, colors and contact options.
process_title: A simple process with a clear result.
process_1_text: We discuss what the business does, who its customers are and what the website should achieve.
process_2_text: The template becomes a real website with the client's copy, images, colors and services.
process_3_text: The finished website can be published on GitHub Pages or another hosting service with a custom domain.
about_title: Websites that do not try to be something they are not – they simply present what a business does well.
about_p1: The goal of MesterWeb is simple: create modern, clear and easy-to-use websites that help local businesses build a stronger online presence.
about_p2: The foundation is reusable, so different versions can later be created efficiently for many professions.
contact_title: Would you like a similar website?
contact_text: Tell me briefly about your idea, or contact me directly by email, phone or WhatsApp. The first consultation is free.
contact_placeholder_text: The real MesterWeb phone number, email address and social profiles will be added here later.
form_message_placeholder: Briefly describe what you have in mind...
form_note: Submitting opens the message in your device's email application addressed to MesterWeb.
sales_title: A good website can be the first impression people get of your business.
sales_text: The MesterWeb foundation is ready to become separate website versions for hairdressers, electricians, auto mechanics, restaurants and other local service providers.
footer_demo: Demo website – content and contact details can be customized later.
example_cleaning_text: Home, upholstery, carpet and window cleaning with quote request.
example_plumber_text: Plumbing, drain unblocking, fast fault reporting and quote requests.
example_apartment_text: Gallery, amenities, local area, enquiries and multilingual presentation.
consult_eyebrow: YOU DON'T HAVE TO THINK IN TEMPLATES
consult_title: The website adapts to your business.
consult_text: Your website can be created around your own ideas, with a personalised look and tailored content.
consult_1_text: You do not have to accept a fixed template: the website can be adapted to your business goals and style.
consult_2_text: Your own colours, images, services, texts and contact options can all be built into the website.
consult_3_text: We discuss your needs and ideas, and I help you find the solution that best fits your business.
